column1: # expected<TAB>cli<TAB>args. Run by tests/run.sh against `approve check`, using mac/rules.example.json.
# patterns match word by word from the start, so a word later in the command is not enough
# --help counts only as a standalone flag at the end, never inside a value
# purging executions deletes history, so it asks
# pointing a CLI at another server or key always asks, even for a read
# redirect flags on a free call always ask, also inside a cluster of short flags
